nodes.label: Paddle Integration Policy
nodes.rationale: Paddle's API and SDKs change often, so the paddle-docs MCP must be consulted before writing integration code rather than trusting model knowledge. All development targets sandbox; sandbox API keys contain _sdbx and client tokens start with test_.

nodes.label: Webhook Signature Verification
nodes.rationale: paddle.webhooks.unmarshal needs the RAW body. NestJS must be created with rawBody:true and read req.rawBody — if the body arrives already parsed as JSON the signature never validates.

nodes.label: Webhook Idempotency
nodes.rationale: Paddle retries webhook deliveries at-least-once, so handlers must deduplicate by event_id or the same event is processed twice.

nodes.label: Paddle Environment Variables
nodes.rationale: API_PADDLE, PADDLE_WEBHOOK_SECRET and PADDLE_ENV are server-only. Only VITE_-prefixed vars reach the frontend bundle, so an API key must never carry that prefix; VITE_PADDLE_CLIENT_TOKEN is public by design.

nodes.label: Secrets Committed To Git
nodes.rationale: Known outstanding risk: .env and .env.example are versioned in git with real credentials (Neon, SMTP, JWT, Paddle). No new secrets should be added to those files until they are removed from the repository.

nodes.label: CloudCore Stack
nodes.rationale: SaaS panel for VPS infrastructure automation. NestJS 11 + TypeScript backend in src/, React 19 + Vite frontend in frontend/, PostgreSQL on Neon accessed with the pg driver directly (no ORM), app auth via JWT.
